semantic_qualification: The mutation had ALREADY LANDED when the process was killed (barrier context outcome=applied; audit id present in the hold-state evidence). The recovery wording in THIS export ('Background update could not finish / interrupted by a server restart') wrongly implies nothing changed. The durable effect is recorded SEPARATELY from the interrupted completion: the canvas audit row (85cf669e...) is the effect; the reconciliation to failed is the completion-report status. Fixed in the working tree after this run: recovery now detects the landed effect (fork-time snapshot hash vs current canvas) and words the outcome 'applied before the interruption' with the effect recorded in the message metadata (effect_on_canvas).
